summary:
**Market summary: session of 2026-11-06**

U.S. equities were mixed in the latest session. The Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) rose 1.40% and the Russell 2000 (IWM) gained 0.99%, while the Dow (DIA) fell 0.40% and the S&P 500 (SPY) edged up 0.31%. Over five sessions, however, SPY fell 2.70%, QQQ 4.98%, and the Technology sector (XLK) 8.23%. Energy (XLE) led five-day declines at -12.00%, with oil (USO) down 12.10%. Gold (GLD) rose 4.71% over the same period, and the U.S. dollar (UUP) gained 0.73% on the day. Consumer staples (XLP) was the weakest sector on the day at -1.28%.

Among eligible stocks, OBX (+44.4%) led gainers, while PRAA (-36.7%) led losers. Uniti Group (UNIT) was the most-mentioned ticker in the day's news. It reported a Q3 net loss of $244.5M and an EPS miss, but raised its FY2026 sales guidance. KeyBanc downgraded Zillow Group (ZG) to Sector Weight, and Dropbox announced a $1 billion convertible notes offering.
